shortDescription: Orlen GPW:PKN Chief Executive Ireneusz Fafara is optimistic a deal to buy chemicals company Grupa Azoty's GPW:ATT Polimery Police plant could be closed soon.Shares in Azoty fell as much as 5.2% on Thursday after a report that a legal dispute could jeopardise the sale.
